dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge follows a concave spline with a pronounced secondary indentation near the posterior base, creating a distinct falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Obtuse shape classification with a broad rounded pixel radius, lacking any acute termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior margin with an angular incline of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal baseline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum horizontal pixel base width to vertical pixel height ratio of approximately 1.5:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct triangular notch is visible on the lower third of the trailing edge; scattered white punctate markings/lesions are present across the mid-lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Subtle mottled pigmentation and tonal variations are visible along the lower portion of the fin where it meets the dorsal ridge.
